title: Terms Of Use
metaDescription: Terms for using the Skin Essence website: the information here is general, not medical advice, and results vary. Clinic in Kalyani Nagar, Pune.
intro: By using this website you agree to the terms below. Please read them together with our privacy policy.

sections.heading: General information, not medical advice
paragraphs: The content on this website is general information about skin, hair and cosmetic concerns and the treatments we offer. It is not medical advice and does not replace a consultation with a qualified dermatologist, who will examine you and advise on your individual case.
Do not start, stop or change any medicine or treatment on the basis of what you read here. If you have an urgent medical problem, contact a doctor or hospital.

sections.heading: Results vary
paragraphs: Descriptions of treatments, number of sessions, downtime and outcomes are typical ranges. Individual results vary with skin type, the condition being treated, aftercare and other factors, and no particular result can be promised.

sections.heading: Enquiries and appointments
paragraphs: Sending the form is a request, not a confirmed appointment. Your appointment is confirmed when the clinic contacts you. Please give accurate contact details so we can reach you.
Fees are explained at the clinic. Any prices mentioned on the website are indicative and may change.

sections.heading: Testimonials and images
paragraphs: Patient experiences shared on this site are individual and do not predict your own result. Photographs may be representative images rather than photographs of the clinic, its patients or its equipment; where that is the case we say so.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The text, design and clinic photographs on this website belong to Skin Essence or are used under licence. You may share links to our pages; please do not copy the content without permission.

sections.heading: External links
paragraphs: The site links to third-party services such as Google Maps and WhatsApp. We are not responsible for their content or how they handle your data.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: We take care to keep this website accurate and available, but it is provided as it is, and to the extent permitted by law we are not liable for loss arising from reliance on general information published here.

sections.heading: Changes and governing law
paragraphs: We may update these terms from time to time; the date at the top shows the latest revision. These terms are governed by the laws of India.
